import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
packet=Path('/tmp/ns2604-tier1-codex-ready-20261010-OWFxvw/work/packets/foundation__workers.json')
data=packet.read_bytes()
p=json.loads(data)
print('packet_sha256',hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
refs={r for c in p['candidates'] if c['adopted'] for r in c['evidence_refs']}
for ref in sorted(refs):
    if '://' in ref:
        print('EXTERNAL',ref)
        continue
    path=Path(ref)
    print(path.stat().st_size if path.exists() else 'MISSING',ref)
